To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) people spend little time in working activities before switching, 2) people are frequently interrupted, and 3) interruptions have negative effects on people's productivity.
work is fragmented in two ways: (1) people average very little time in working activities before switching and (2) they have many interruptions to those activities.
work is highly fragmented: people spend little time in a work sphere before switching and have a large number of interruptions, both of which are exacerbated in a collocated setting.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nature of fragmented and interrupted work.
understanding the nature of fragmented and continuous work, and with the design of technology to support people to manage their work.
the nature of fragmented information work and the implications this has for the design of technology to support people in their work.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
work is highly fragmented.
the fragmentation of work is an important phenomenon that needs to be taken into account in the design of work environments.
people work in a very fragmented way, and this fragmentation is a result of the way they work.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown how work is fragmented in terms of time and space, and how this fragmentation is a natural consequence of the way people work, and not an artifact of the technology they use.
work is fragmented and technology can support the continuity of work by helping people to maintain context.
people work in a fragmented fashion and that this fragmentation can be supported by technology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
people experience work as fragmented, but that they are not necessarily aware of it.
people need tools that support their work, but they also need tools that support them in managing interruptions, and managing the transitions from one activity to another.
people need to have a better understanding of their own working sphere and how to manage it.
